errors.text_span: was den höchsten Balken im gesamten Diagramm darstellt
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states that the Welthandel value of 5.4 in the 2000er Jahre is the highest bar in the entire chart. However, the Exporte Deutschland value of 5.3 in the same decade is nearly the same height, and the description does not clarify this.
The machine description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the average percentage values of global GDP, global trade, German exports, and German industrial production.
The machine description does not mention the specific colors of the bars (dark green, light green, dark blue, light blue) as described in the reference.
The machine description does not mention that the bars are annotated with their exact numerical values at their ends.
